issues.problem: The paper DEFINES E0 metrically (l.1944: R^3 with the singular structure induced by -2 dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2); the file defines it as the structure for which the projection from the cylinder, structured by pullback along btzDevM on {r>0}, is an a.e. morphism (IsBTZStructure). The link 'the metric's structure = the one D develops' is SCOPE D-5's hand check, not formalized ('the library has no metric notion'). That is a reading, and by CAMPAIGN.md/DEC-27 practice a row resting on an unruled reading is partial and unmarked; the REPORT itself concedes this ('if the master reads this as a reading needing a ruling, the row is partial pending it') yet records closed + marked. No DEC covers it: DEC-47/52 rule ex:quotient_base, whose structure IS defined by D; sec:mot_BTZ's is not. DEC-81 (ex:take_closed_unit_disc read metrically, metric statements proved) shows the author does not treat the metric content as dispensable. The gap is also avoidable at modest cost: D is polynomial on R x (0,inf) x R, so D^*(-dt^2+dx^2+dy^2) = -2dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2 is an fderiv computation (minkQ (fderiv D p w) = -2 w_tau w_r + w_r^2 + r^2 w_theta^2).
issues.fix: Either (a) obtain an author ruling accepting 'E0 := Gamma_{2pi}\(D_inf x R) with the structure developed by the paper's D on {r>0}' (the paper's own section 4.4 recalls E0 through D, and l.678 identifies it with ex:quotient_base's white hole), after which the row closes as reported; or (b) prove the pullback-metric identity for the paper's D (and its compatibility with Isom0-charts) in the file and cite it in the checklist; until (a) or (b), record the row as partial and drop the bold mark.

issues.problem: The formal developing map gives y = +r theta where the paper prints y = -r theta; the docstring says 'up to the orientation of theta (the spatial reflection y -> -y)'. The reflection y -> -y alone is NOT in Isom0 = Causal.Flat.isom 2 (det 1); the correct identification is the cylinder homeomorphism theta -> -theta (D_paper(tau,r,theta) = btzDevM 0 btzV0 (r,-theta,2 tau)), which conjugates Gamma_{2pi} to itself (k -> -k). This identification, and hence that the paper's literal D defines the same E0, is asserted in prose and not proved; no choice of v in btz_virt_tame realises the printed sign (the r theta coefficient is v.2.1 > 0).
issues.fix: State and prove D_paper = btzDevM 0 btzV0 o (r,theta,t) -> (r,-theta,2t) (or the induced structures coincide under that Gamma-equivariant-up-to-inversion homeomorphism), and correct the docstring wording ('the reflection theta -> -theta of the cylinder', not 'the spatial reflection y -> -y').

issues.problem: l.2250 also asserts that Gamma(BTZ~/BTZ) 'stabilizes point-wise the singular locus'. Only used inside the proof of btzDev_smul_all (the local hk); no stated theorem that every deck transformation fixes p^-1(Sing) pointwise. Likewise 'taking gamma A generator': btzHolonomy_generator treats k = 1 only (the other generator gives btzHol^-1, also parabolic, unstated). Unlabelled infrastructure, so not a ledger gap.
issues.fix: Add btz_deck_fix_sing: forall gamma, forall e with e.base in Sing, gamma e = e; and state parabolicity for btzHolonomy of either generator (or of every nontrivial gamma).

issues.problem: Recorded as 'G = Isom(E^{1,2})'. Causal.Flat.isom 2 is the subgroup whose linear part lies in Causal.Flat.lorentz 2 = {preserves minkQ, preserves future causal vectors, det = 1}, i.e. Isom0 -- which is what the paper uses (l.668 'G = Isom0(X)'). The Lean is right; the description is imprecise.
issues.fix: Write 'G = Isom0(E^{1,2}) (orientation and time-orientation preserving), Causal.Flat.isom 2'.

issues.problem: Docstring and dispatch say E0 is 'gx's white hole GX.btz_whitehole_isom0 transported by the bridge'; the file in fact rebuilds it with quotientBase over Causal.Flat.isom 2 and never relates its structure to the strict library's NullIsom0 white hole through nullIsom0EquivIsom/nullToMink. Harmless for prop:BTZ_virt_tame, but the advertised transport is not a theorem, and downstream packages (WP-39c/d) may assume it.
issues.fix: Either reword the docstring ('the same construction as GX.btz_whitehole_isom0, over Causal.Flat.isom 2'), or prove the transport statement (the bridge maps the NullIsom0 white-hole atlas of btzDev x0 v to the Causal.Flat.isom 2 atlas of btzDevM x0 v).

issues.problem: Both are stated for an arbitrary homeomorphism Phi, with no hPhi tying it to the base, so 'D' there is btzDevM o Phi for any Phi; that D is THE developing map of BTZ~ is a separate theorem (btz_isRegDevelopingOnReg, which needs hPhi). True and not weaker, but the docstring's 'D injective on BTZ~' reads as about the developing map.
issues.fix: Optionally add hPhi to these two statements or note in the docstring that they hold for every Phi and that hPhi makes btzDevM o Phi the developing map.
